verdict.rationale: Extend references a web-based Extend Studio where processors are iterated on and versioned [extend-docs-40, extend-docs-18], and a dashboard exists [extend-docs-68]. That implies a no-code UI for trying parse/extract configs, but no evidence explicitly describes uploading or dragging a document into a playground and viewing results before writing code. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a drag-and-drop web playground, evidence of viewing parse/extract output in the UI without code, hands-on or independent corroboration of a pre-code trial flow.
